intuition: Each run stores a remaining count and one repeated value, so skips can consume whole runs.

brute_force.approach: Expand the entire run-length encoding into an array and index into it.
brute_force.time: construction O(total expanded length), next O(1)

optimal.approach: Track the current run and subtract requested consumption until the final consumed value is found.
optimal.time: next O(number of runs crossed), construction O(1)

edge_cases: A request that consumes beyond the stream returns -1.
A request may end exactly at a run boundary.
